description: Create a Collection Ad creative: a main image or video plus 4-20 product tiles, each a square image (1:1, at least 120x120 px) that opens its own https page, and a fallback page for a swipe on the main Snap. Creates the product tiles, the row that holds them and the COLLECTION creative; nothing delivers. Use the returned creative with snap_create_ad (ad type COLLECTION). Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

fallback_url.description: https:// page opened by a swipe on the main Snap

name.description: Name to give the new item. Shown in Ads Manager.

products.description: The 4 to 20 products shown in the Collection ad, each with an image and its own https page.

image_media_id.description: Product tile image (READY), at least 120x120 px

profile_id.description: Brand (public) profile id. Optional: defaults to SNAP_BRAND_PROFILE_ID.

name: snap_create_collection_creative
